import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    if not feats.ids:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Check for association with outcome
    effects = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        col = feats.column(fid)
        y = feats.y
        x = feats.x[:, col]
        tstat, _ = stats.ttest_ind(x[y==1], x[y==0])
        effects.append((abs(tstat), fid))
    
    effects.sort(reverse=True)
    
    # Check stratum consistency
    stratum_consistent = True
    if len(set(feats.stratum)) > 1:
        strata = set(feats.stratum)
        for s in strata:
            mask = np.array([x == s for x in feats.stratum])
            if np.sum(mask) < 2:
                continue
            y_s = feats.y[mask]
            if len(np.unique(y_s)) < 2:
                continue
            x_s = feats.x[mask]
            # For each feature, check if effect is consistent
            for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
                col = feats.column(fid)
                x_f = x_s[:, col]
                tstat, _ = stats.ttest_ind(x_f[y_s==1], x_f[y_s==0])
                # Simple check: if effect is very different, mark inconsistent
                if abs(tstat) < 1.0:  # arbitrary threshold
                    stratum_consistent = False
                    break
            if not stratum_consistent:
                break
    
    # Select top features by effect size
    top_features = [fid for _, fid in effects[:MAX_DRIVERS]]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation
    keep = []
    used = set()
    for fid in top_features:
        if fid in used:
            continue
        keep.append(fid)
        used.add(fid)
        # Find correlated features to exclude
        col = feats.column(fid)
        x_fid = feats.x[:, col]
        for other_fid in feats.ids:
            if other_fid == fid or other_fid in used:
                continue
            other_col = feats.column(other_fid)
            x_other = feats.x[:, other_col]
            corr = np.corrcoef(x_fid, x_other)[0,1]
            if abs(corr) >= 0.6:
                used.add(other_fid)
    
    # If no mechanism expected, return empty design
    if not stratum_consistent or len(keep) == 0:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Build logistic regression features
    drivers = tuple(keep[:MAX_DRIVERS])
    columns = tuple(keep[:MAX_DRIVERS])
    products = ()
    loadings = {fid: 1.0 for fid in keep[:MAX_DRIVERS]}
    
    # Ensure we don't exceed max drivers in final result
    drivers = drivers[:MAX_DRIVERS]
    columns = columns[:MAX_DRIVERS]
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=products, loadings=loadings)
